- [ ] Substantive specification change (requires 14-day public discussion)

_Link to the issue this PR addresses, if applicable._

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are DCO-signed (`Signed-off-by: Name <email>` on every commit)
- [ ] Commit messages follow conventional commit style
- [ ] No em dashes in new or modified content
- [ ] No marketing language
- [ ] Hugo build passes locally (`hugo --minify`)
- [ ] If this PR adds or modifies an ADR, LIP, or changelog entry, the related BACKLOG item is moved to COMPLETED in the same PR (or `Resolves: BACKLOG#item-id` is in the commit message)
- [ ] Internal links resolve
- [ ] If modifying normative spec text, the 14-day discussion period has started or completed
- [ ] If adding an extension registration, the extension proposal issue has been accepted

## Test plan

_How to verify the change. For documentation changes, list the pages to review. For code changes, describe the testing._
